title: GORILLA GRIP Heavy Duty Mortar and Pestle Set with Slip Resistant Base, 100% Granite Stone Molcajete Guacamole Bowl, Grind Seeds Spices, Crush Garlic, Kitchen Muddler for Fresh Herbs, 1.5 Cup, Gray
description:
About this item
BUILT GORILLA GRIP TOUGH: the last mortar and pestle set you will ever buy, the Gorilla Grip Mortar and Pestle Set is ultra durable and built tough; featuring a heavy duty grinding pestle that crushes and mashes ingredients effortlessly, the mortar and pestle is ultra durable, and scratch resistant; its heavy base helps keep it in place and resist slipping and sliding, even while crushing the heaviest of ingredients
100 PERCENT NATURAL GRANITE: Gorilla Grip granite is sourced from natural granite mines, then handcrafted with care; granite is cut, shaped and polished into the mortar and pestle; natural granite has been used for generations due to its natural durability and long lasting use; no more heavy mixers or food processors, this granite mortar and pestle set takes the effort out of food prep while also helps release the natural flavors of the ingredients
GUACAMOLE, SPICES, NUTS, AND MORE: not just for guacamole, the mortar and pestle set is a great option for nearly any ingredient; crush up spices and herbs; create homemade pesto by grinding up nuts and seeds; serve up fresh dips; even a great choice for homemade dressings and salsas; impress your entire guest list with the tastiest dishes ever
NON SCRATCH BOTTOM: even though the mortar and pestle set is heavy duty, it resists scratching countertops and surfaces; it features an optional foam bottom underside that helps protect surfaces, while also helping to prevent slipping and sliding while you prep
LARGE CAPACITY MORTAR AND PESTLE IS A PERFECT GIFT: mortar and pestle set comes in 3 sizes; large size measures 5.2” x 3.2”, weighs 3.9lbs, and holds up to 1.5 cups of ingredients; a perfect year round gift for anyone who enjoys cooking; beautifully designed so that it can be displayed on any countertop and add to the décor of the kitchen
reviews_5s:
The Gorilla Grip Heavy Duty Mortar and Pestle has become an essential tool in my kitchen. From the moment I unpacked it, I could tell it was made with serious quality in mind—heavy, solid, and perfectly balanced for grinding with ease.

Whether I’m crushing spices, grinding herbs, or making fresh guacamole, it handles every task effortlessly. The textured interior provides great traction for grinding, and the sturdy base keeps it stable during use. Cleaning is also surprisingly easy for such a rugged tool.

It’s not just functional—it looks great on the counter too. If you're looking for a durable, dependable mortar and pestle that delivers real results, this is the one to get. Highly recommended!Fantastic mortar and pestle. Obviously works very well. I mainly use it in Indian cooking to grind up garlic, chilli and spices. I love the rugged stone appearance - personally I'm not a fan of a polished outside. Easy to clean, dries quick too. I like the nonslip bottom as well.

Its heavy of course (its literally stone) but dont let that bother you.The person who wrote the “seasoning” instructions must have stock in electronic spice grinder manufacturing. It took me over an hour to grind the handful of rice and it uses infrequently used muscles. It feels real solid with good manufacturing and packaging. The provided “rubber” base is really nice for keeping the bowl from moving while in use and protecting our counters.Beautiful Mortar. Like so much better than the gray ones sitting on my counter. I don't think it's the mortars fault, but trying to powder hard Hawthorne berries didn't quite work out as I had hoped. It definitely got them crushed, but more like cracked pepper than a powder consistency. Will use for other things of course.Legit. Works well!Excellent!!!
Me encantó.Awesome and great qualitySolid material attractive and functionalThis is perfect for me….
Now I only need to decide if I’ll use it to mull pigment in my studio or for pesto or small batches of guacamole…!
Hmmmmnnnn……..!!!
Also, it comes with easy to follow step by step for simply seasoning of it!Good quality
